items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results, operations deploy-health/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Exact decision: preserve private and parked gates, permit only reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior, and continue the existing read-only evidence matrix only.

Security review rejects retaining the proposed control-plane product proposal this cycle. It is premature while delivery is saturated, failed and stranded work remains open, and security evidence is unavailable. Reconsider only as an isolated, read-only prototype after containment clears, with explicit access boundaries, least privilege, secret handling, tenant/site isolation, auditability, failure containment, rollback, and owner-approved security review.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication, access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, requeue unchanged work, or conduct external outreach.
